title: Underfloor heating and a heat pump: the perfect combination for your home
pageTitle: Underfloor heating and a heat pump: the perfect combination | AZGS
description: Why underfloor heating and a heat pump work so well together: low temperature, high efficiency and lower energy use. Practical advice for renovations in the Utrecht region.
intro: The move from gas boilers to heat pumps is accelerating in the Netherlands. Subsidies, lower energy use and the shift toward gas-free homes make heat pumps increasingly attractive. But many homeowners then ask: will this work with my current heating system? In most homes, underfloor heating is one of the best partners for a heat pump. This guide explains why, and what to check before you choose this combination.
